invariants.rationale: The method does nothing except when element name is 'Layer'; the state is unchanged otherwise.
If a layer was loaded, then a layer object was added to map's layer list, making its size at least one.
If a layer was loaded, the last layer in map should correspond to the newly added non-null layer.
The method assumes map is not null throughout, as it is dereferenced multiple times.
The method assumes element is not null.
